projects.name: Blue Horizon
projects.description: Blue Horizon PTY website: sells Panama as a destination —beaches, rainforests, culture, music and food— with zero package pressure. City tours, Emberá community, Canal, real traveler reviews and a shared photo gallery.

measurement.label: Measurement · GEO optimization
measurement.title: Ready for AI search (GEO / Agent-Ready)
measurement.imageAlt: Is It Agent Ready audit of Blue Horizon scoring 63/100, Level 4 Agent-Integrated
measurement.intro: On this project I didn't only care about the visual experience and load speed for humans, but also about how AI agents and conversational search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude) interpret the web. The site scored 63/100 (Level 4: Agent-Integrated) in the Is It Agent Ready technical audit.
measurement.whyText: Because architecture should serve the business purpose, not checkbox-filling. Blue Horizon is an informational, commercial site for a tour agency — not a platform with an autonomous-agent backend. The audit deducts points for missing MCP servers, OAuth for bots, A2A transactions or machine-to-machine commerce — adding them here would be pointless complexity and overhead.
measurement.outro: This ensures that when someone asks an AI assistant about tours or experiences in Panama, the model can find, read and cite Blue Horizon without errors or hallucinations.

pagespeed.label: Performance · PageSpeed Insights
pagespeed.title: Speed and quality measured in production
pagespeed.note: Audit on the live production URL. On desktop performance hits 97 with SEO and best practices at 100; on mobile it drops to 66 — expected on throttled network/CPU — while keeping accessibility at 93 and SEO at 100.
